        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">6</span><p class="sp-r">The Angel Over the Chair sums to 105, which reduces to 6: care, the one who watches over the chair.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XIIII Tempérance (Temperance)</span><p class="sp-r">Tempérance is a winged figure pouring slowly, like the one bending over the chair.</p></div>

        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">11</span><p class="sp-r">The Seventh Night of the Mark sums to 119, which reduces to 11, a master number kept as it is: the mark seen clearly once it settles.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">VII Le Chariot (The Chariot)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Chariot is card seven, for the seven nights the new mark needs.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">2</span><p class="sp-r">The Hour Without Words sums to 101, which reduces to 2: union, two people reading each other without speaking.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XII Le Pendu (The Hanged Man)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Pendu is the held pause where nothing moves; the hour without words.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">8</span><p class="sp-r">The Butterfly on the Nape sums to 98, which reduces to 8: weight, wings that hold still.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVII L&#x27;Étoile (The Star)</span><p class="sp-r">L&#x27;Étoile kneels under an open sky with a bird in the tree; the butterfly hears the sky and stays.</p></div>

        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">3</span><p class="sp-r">Under the Ink sums to 57, which reduces to 3: expression, what the ink says when the mouth will not.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVIII La Lune (The Moon)</span><p class="sp-r">La Lune shows what lives under the surface; darkness lives in the needle-track.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">11</span><p class="sp-r">The Empress sums to 47, which reduces to 11, a master number kept as it is: clear sight from the one who sits on the throne.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">III L&#x27;Impératrice (The Empress)</span><p class="sp-r">The Empress is card III: L&#x27;Impératrice on her throne with sceptre and shield.</p></div>

        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink">The tarot room</h1>
      </div>

    <section class="tarot-why" aria-label="Why I made this deck"><div class="wrap"><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter tarot-why-letter"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">Of these cards</p><h2 class="ms-title">Why I made this deck</h2><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="tarot-why-copy"><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">I practise the dark arts. Within this hall</span><span class="ms-l">the Porcelain Ballerina has her place:</span><span class="ms-l">this house keeps the record of it all,</span><span class="ms-l">the art behind it, and its every trace.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">The twenty-two great trumps I drew anew,</span><span class="ms-l">more dark, more dangerous to behold,</span><span class="ms-l">and yet each card still holds its meaning true,</span><span class="ms-l">the meaning that it carried from of old.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">So sit, and ask. The reading laid for you</span><span class="ms-l">is meant to be as true, as wholly true,</span><span class="ms-l">as any that a living reader reads,</span><span class="ms-l">card after card, as each one leads.</span></p></div><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></section>

    <header class="page-head page-head-tight wd-head">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="kicker">The archive &middot; a promise kept</p>
        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink">Wards</h1>
        <p class="wd-lede">Protective customs only. Nothing here calls, binds or harms.</p>
      </div>
    </header>
    <section class="wards" aria-label="Wards">
      <div class="wrap">
        <article class="pa-warning pw-poem wd-intro">
          <span class="pw-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <div class="pw-text wd-intro-text"><p>I promised a page. Here it is.</p><p>Only wards. Old house customs, kept by people who never wrote them down. Nothing on this page calls anything, binds anything or hurts anyone. If a ward ever asks you to, it is not a ward.</p><p>They are not medicine and they are not a promise. They are a way of keeping a door shut, and of remembering that you are the one who holds the key.</p></div>
          <p class="pw-sig">&mdash; M.A.</p>
          <span class="pw-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </article>
        <div class="wd-grid">
        <details class="wd-card wdl" id="ward-i">
          <summary class="wdl-front">
            <span class="wd-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="wd-num" aria-hidden="true">I</span>
            <h2 class="wd-title" id="wd-I">The salt line</h2>
            <span class="wd-line">A threshold remembers who crossed it.</span>
            <span class="wdl-wax" aria-hidden="true"><i class="wdl-cord"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-l"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-r"></i></span>
            <span class="wdl-hint"><span class="wdl-closed">Break the seal</span><span class="wdl-opened">Fold it shut</span></span>
          </summary>
          <div class="wdl-body">
          <h3 class="wd-h">What you need</h3><ul class="wd-need"><li>A handful of plain salt</li><li>A broom</li><li>A quiet hour, before dark</li></ul>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How</h3><ol class="wd-how"><li>Sweep the threshold first, from the inside out, so nothing old is left lying there.</li><li>Pour a thin line of salt across the inside of the door, from one side of the frame to the other. Do not leave a gap.</li><li>Say it plainly, once: nothing passes here that I did not ask in.</li></ol>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How to close</h3><div class="wd-close"><p>In the morning, sweep the salt outward over the step and let the weather take it.</p><p>Never use that salt again. Never cook with it.</p></div>
          </div>
        </details><details class="wd-card wdl" id="ward-ii">
          <summary class="wdl-front">
            <span class="wd-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="wd-num" aria-hidden="true">II</span>
            <h2 class="wd-title" id="wd-II">The candle and the closed circle</h2>
            <span class="wd-line">A circle with a gap in it is only a door.</span>
            <span class="wdl-wax" aria-hidden="true"><i class="wdl-cord"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-l"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-r"></i></span>
            <span class="wdl-hint"><span class="wdl-closed">Break the seal</span><span class="wdl-opened">Fold it shut</span></span>
          </summary>
          <div class="wdl-body">
          <h3 class="wd-h">What you need</h3><ul class="wd-need"><li>One plain white candle</li><li>A fireproof dish to stand it in</li><li>Salt</li><li>A window you can open</li></ul>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How</h3><ol class="wd-how"><li>Stand the candle in the dish on a clear table, far from cloth and paper. Never on the floor.</li><li>Draw a ring of salt around the dish, and close it. Walk the ring once with your eyes before you light the wick.</li><li>Sit with the flame and keep your own counsel. Nothing is invited. You are only keeping the light company.</li><li>Never leave a flame alone in a room, not even for a moment.</li></ol>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How to close</h3><div class="wd-close"><p>Snuff the flame, do not blow it out. Say: this is finished.</p><p>Open the window for a breath of air. Sweep the salt into the dish and carry it outside, away from the door.</p></div>
          </div>
        </details><details class="wd-card wdl" id="ward-iii">
          <summary class="wdl-front">
            <span class="wd-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="wd-num" aria-hidden="true">III</span>
            <h2 class="wd-title" id="wd-III">Iron by the door</h2>
            <span class="wd-line">Iron has stood guard at doors longer than anyone remembers.</span>
            <span class="wdl-wax" aria-hidden="true"><i class="wdl-cord"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-l"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-r"></i></span>
            <span class="wdl-hint"><span class="wdl-closed">Break the seal</span><span class="wdl-opened">Fold it shut</span></span>
          </summary>
          <div class="wdl-body">
          <h3 class="wd-h">What you need</h3><ul class="wd-need"><li>An old iron key, or an iron nail</li><li>A length of red thread</li></ul>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How</h3><ol class="wd-how"><li>Thread the key on the red thread and tie the ends with three knots.</li><li>Hang it inside the front door, above the frame, where it can see whoever enters.</li><li>Touch it when you come home late. That is all it asks.</li></ol>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How to close</h3><div class="wd-close"><p>Once a year, take it down. Wash it in cold, clean water, dry it well so it does not rust, and hang it again on new thread.</p></div>
          </div>
        </details><details class="wd-card wdl" id="ward-iv">
          <summary class="wdl-front">
            <span class="wd-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="wd-num" aria-hidden="true">IV</span>
            <h2 class="wd-title" id="wd-IV">Rosemary and bay</h2>
            <span class="wd-line">Green things kept at the edges of a house.</span>
            <span class="wdl-wax" aria-hidden="true"><i class="wdl-cord"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-l"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-r"></i></span>
            <span class="wdl-hint"><span class="wdl-closed">Break the seal</span><span class="wdl-opened">Fold it shut</span></span>
          </summary>
          <div class="wdl-body">
          <h3 class="wd-h">What you need</h3><ul class="wd-need"><li>A sprig of rosemary</li><li>Three dried bay leaves</li><li>A small cloth bag or a dish</li></ul>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How</h3><ol class="wd-how"><li>Lay the rosemary along the top of a door frame or a window ledge.</li><li>Put the bay leaves in the cloth bag and keep it near where you sleep, or under the mat at the door.</li><li>Breathe the rosemary in when you pass it. Let the house smell like someone lives there.</li></ol>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How to close</h3><div class="wd-close"><p>When the leaves are dry and brittle, return them to the earth: bury them, or give them to the garden.</p><p>Put fresh ones in their place. A ward that is forgotten is no ward.</p></div>
          </div>
        </details><details class="wd-card wdl" id="ward-v">
          <summary class="wdl-front">
            <span class="wd-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="wd-num" aria-hidden="true">V</span>
            <h2 class="wd-title" id="wd-V">Closing a session</h2>
            <span class="wd-line">Whatever you open, you close. Out loud.</span>
            <span class="wdl-wax" aria-hidden="true"><i class="wdl-cord"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-l"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-r"></i></span>
            <span class="wdl-hint"><span class="wdl-closed">Break the seal</span><span class="wdl-opened">Fold it shut</span></span>
          </summary>
          <div class="wdl-body">
          <h3 class="wd-h">What you need</h3><ul class="wd-need"><li>Every light in the room</li><li>A glass of water</li><li>Your own name</li></ul>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How</h3><ol class="wd-how"><li>When you are done with a reading, with a song played too loud too late, with a night spent too long in the dark, do not simply walk away.</li><li>Say plainly that it is over: this is finished, and everything goes back where it came from.</li><li>Close what you opened. The book, the lid, the box. Put the cards away face down. Cover the mirror if you uncovered it.</li></ol>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How to close</h3><div class="wd-close"><p>Turn on every light. Drink the water slowly. Wash your hands in cold water.</p><p>Say your own name once, as if you were calling yourself home.</p></div>
          </div>
        </details><details class="wd-card wdl" id="ward-vi">
          <summary class="wdl-front">
            <span class="wd-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="wd-num" aria-hidden="true">VI</span>
            <h2 class="wd-title" id="wd-VI">Grounding</h2>
            <span class="wd-line">Come back down into your own weight.</span>
            <span class="wdl-wax" aria-hidden="true"><i class="wdl-cord"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-l"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-r"></i></span>
            <span class="wdl-hint"><span class="wdl-closed">Break the seal</span><span class="wdl-opened">Fold it shut</span></span>
          </summary>
          <div class="wdl-body">
          <h3 class="wd-h">What you need</h3><ul class="wd-need"><li>Bare feet</li><li>Earth, stone or a plain floor</li><li>Something to eat, a little bread or salt</li></ul>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How</h3><ol class="wd-how"><li>Stand with your feet flat and apart. Let your weight sink into your heels.</li><li>Breathe in slowly. Breathe out longer than you breathed in. Five times.</li><li>Name five things you can see, four you can hear, three you can touch. Say them out loud.</li></ol>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How to close</h3><div class="wd-close"><p>Eat something small. Drink water. Step outside if you can, and look at something far away.</p></div>
          </div>
        </details><details class="wd-card wdl" id="ward-vii">
          <summary class="wdl-front">
            <span class="wd-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="wd-num" aria-hidden="true">VII</span>
            <h2 class="wd-title" id="wd-VII">Fresh air and water</h2>
            <span class="wd-line">Old air keeps old company. Let it out.</span>
            <span class="wdl-wax" aria-hidden="true"><i class="wdl-cord"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-l"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-r"></i></span>
            <span class="wdl-hint"><span class="wdl-closed">Break the seal</span><span class="wdl-opened">Fold it shut</span></span>
          </summary>
          <div class="wdl-body">
          <h3 class="wd-h">What you need</h3><ul class="wd-need"><li>Every window in the house</li><li>A bowl of cold water with a pinch of salt</li><li>A clean cloth</li></ul>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How</h3><ol class="wd-how"><li>Open every window, even in winter, even for one minute. Let the air run through from room to room.</li><li>Dip the cloth and wipe the door handles, the window sills and the threshold, always moving toward the door.</li><li>Leave the rooms you sleep in for last.</li></ol>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How to close</h3><div class="wd-close"><p>Pour the water out on the ground outside, away from the door. Rinse the bowl.</p><p>Close the windows from the top of the house to the bottom.</p></div>
          </div>
        </details><details class="wd-card wdl" id="ward-viii">
          <summary class="wdl-front">
            <span class="wd-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="wd-num" aria-hidden="true">VIII</span>
            <h2 class="wd-title" id="wd-VIII">The covered mirror</h2>
            <span class="wd-line">A mirror at night is a window you forgot to close.</span>
            <span class="wdl-wax" aria-hidden="true"><i class="wdl-cord"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-l"></i><i class="wdl-h wdl-r"></i></span>
            <span class="wdl-hint"><span class="wdl-closed">Break the seal</span><span class="wdl-opened">Fold it shut</span></span>
          </summary>
          <div class="wdl-body">
          <h3 class="wd-h">What you need</h3><ul class="wd-need"><li>A dark cloth for each mirror that faces a bed</li></ul>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How</h3><ol class="wd-how"><li>At night, before you sleep, cover any mirror that can see you sleeping.</li><li>Do not look into it in the dark to see what looks back.</li></ol>
          <h3 class="wd-h">How to close</h3><div class="wd-close"><p>Uncover it in the morning, when there is daylight in the room. Fold the cloth and keep it close.</p></div>
          </div>
        </details>
        </div>
        <p class="wd-foot">If you are frightened, or unwell, a ward is not enough. Turn on the lights and talk to someone living: a friend, a doctor, someone you trust.</p>
        <p class="wd-back"><a class="btn" href="gallery.html#warning">Back to the warning</a></p>
      </div>
    </section>
    <section class="next-step" aria-label="Next step of the rite"><div class="wrap next-inner lit"><span class="seal seal-red seal-next" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="kicker">Next &middot; IV</p><h2 class="next-title">Return to the archive</h2><p class="next-text">The warning is kept there, with everything else.</p><div class="btn-row"><a class="btn btn-solid" href="gallery.html#warning">Back to the warning</a></div></div></section>
